name: Default Artemis Deployment Context
unresolvedNotes: Profile values are prototype placeholders unless overridden by a maintainer-provided local profile.
Phase 5 aligned parameter keys to current Artemis configuration paths; see devdocs/plan/phase-5/parameter-alignment-audit.md for the canonical-key evidence table.
Spring AI settings (spring.ai.*) are shared by Hyperion and Atlas; do not model them as Hyperion-only endpoint data.

Secret values are env: references only (artemis.iris.secret-token, artemis.athena.secret, spring.ai.openai.api-key, artemis.atlas.atlasml.auth-token, artemis.sharing.apikey) and are never stored as plaintext.

database.type, deployment.mode, and ci.provider are deployment-context metadata with no Artemis Spring config key; Artemis selects these via spring.datasource.*, Spring profiles, and artemis.continuous-integration.*. They are not used as artifact-generation targets.

lti.registrationMode records that LTI platform registration is database-managed in Artemis; it has no canonical YAML key and is not generated. artemis.lti.trustExternalLTISystems is property-injected (LtiService) and keeps its camelCase form.

Global Search maps artemis.global-search.enable and artemis.weaviate.enabled; the profile assumes a reachable Weaviate service at artemis.weaviate.http-host and the current Artemis default HTTP/gRPC ports.
AtlasML (artemis.atlas.atlasml.*) is optional and disabled by default unless the feature model adds a dedicated AtlasML capability.
artemis.theia.images is environment-specific; the dotted java.java17 key is a flat-map compromise for structured Theia image values.
Apollon maps artemis.apollon.conversion-service-url and requires the Modeling feature (apollon-requires-modeling constraint).
